__inputs.name: DS_TELEMETRY
__inputs.label: Claude pipeline telemetry
__inputs.description: Loki datasource fed by the shared telemetry/v1 directory (DIR/*.jsonl).

description: Reference dashboard for the telemetry/v1 hand-off contract. Committed by timos-claude-code-plugins as a starting point for the separate cross-repo reporting repo; bind DS_TELEMETRY to your own Loki datasource on import. Every panel filters kind = "run" — an enrichment's outcome describes the enrichment event, so counting both kinds double-counts every enriched run.

panels.title: Runs over time
panels.description: Run volume over the selected window — strictly ENDING volume: a record is one terminal exit, not one invocation, so an extended review loop contributes several and their wall_s spans overlap (count, never sum). count_over_time buckets by each entry's Loki timestamp, NOT by the record's ts field — the query extracts ts as a label, but no LogQL construct can make it the x-axis. Your scrape config must promote ts onto the entry timestamp, or this is a chart of ingest time.

panels.title: Outcome mix
panels.description: How runs ended, across the 4-value outcome enum. Groups on outcome.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time(({job="claude-telemetry"} | json kind="kind", outcome="outcome" | kind = "run")[$__range]))

panels.title: Escalation rate
panels.description: Escalated runs as a fraction of all runs. FILTERS on outcome in the numerator — it does not group by it; adding by (outcome) to both halves does not blank the panel, it PEGS it: the escalated series matches itself, divides to a constant 1, and every other outcome series is dropped — a percentunit stat stuck at 100%. Both halves filter kind = "run" so an enrichment can never inflate either side.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time(({job="claude-telemetry"} | json kind="kind", outcome="outcome" | kind = "run" | outcome = "escalated")[$__range])) / sum(count_over_time(({job="claude-telemetry"} | json kind="kind", outcome="outcome" | kind = "run")[$__range]))

panels.title: Per-pipeline breakdown
panels.description: Run volume per pipeline. pipeline is an OPEN identifier, not an enum — a new pipeline appears here with no dashboard change.

targets.expr: sum by (pipeline) (count_over_time(({job="claude-telemetry"} | json kind="kind", pipeline="pipeline" | kind = "run")[$__range]))

title: Claude pipeline telemetry (telemetry/v1 reference)
